attr.title: Super Blood Hockey
attr.desc:
Relive the golden age of arcade sports gaming with Super Blood Hockey.

Create and manage your team in a violent, dystopic world of no-rules, fast-paced, arcade-style, ice hockey action. Adjust training regimens, control diets, administer black market pharmaceuticals, and provide healthcare (or not) to a ragtag team of convicts at the mercy of your underhanded tactics.
attr.inst:
You must provide the Steam data files for Super Blood Hockey.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/532190

Supports both Windows and Linux versions.
Place all game files into the `superbloodhockey/gamedata` folder.

On first launch, the port auto-detects the device resolution and
patches the game's last resolution slot with the device's resolution and
zoom values, if necessary. Patcher works with version 1.5.4 only.
